rows.grounds: compound of aṣṭādaśa (eighteen), dvīpa (island), and pati (lord); final visarga lost in sandhi before following consonant
compound of aṣṭādaśa (eighteen), purāṇa (purāṇa), and kṛt (maker/doer) from root kṛ

items.question: What domains of sovereignty and authorship are attributed to this figure?
premises: The figure is identified as lord of the eighteen islands.
The figure is identified as maker of the eighteen purāṇas.
Both titles describe authoritative roles over geography and sacred tradition.
items.inference: This figure possesses sovereign rule over the eighteen islands and creative authorship of the eighteen purāṇas.
items.plain_english: He is the lord of the eighteen islands and the maker of the eighteen Purāṇas.
